mission.objective: Implement and execute P11 M2 only: leakage-safe train-only spike-count population features under the frozen protocol.

context: M0 and M1 gates PASS. Read protocol, M1 splits/lock, receipts, unit_qc/session_qc and existing scripts before coding. Do not rerun M1 or change its outputs. Main orchestrator owns milestone status and ops files.
requirements: Use apply_patch edits. Stdlib preferred; no environment or dependency changes needed for M2. Validate prior gates and ALL relevant source/input SHA256 identities, M0 verify, M1 actual split and metadata hashes, raw spike receipt hashes and primary unit selection checksum before extraction.

Generate TRAIN partition counts only, 60 bins per trial [-6,0), 100ms left-closed/right-open, all 613 selected session-local hippocampal units across 23 eligible sessions, keep all zero counts and 0.1s exposure. Read trial_id first and skip non-train rows BEFORE decoding unit or timestamp. Never access validation/test timestamps even for QC. Preserve all frozen files.

Store per-session train features as deterministic JSON or CSV, IDs/trial/session/hemisphere/macro contact plus task/set-size and phase/time metadata. No response/correctness/reaction-time or future covariates used as predictors. Set-size becomes known ONLY from encoding at -5s, not during fixation. History always resets each trial. No smoothing/scaling/projection.

Boundary computation must robustly honor decimal 100ms grid including exact boundaries; use Decimal string timestamp indexing if appropriate. Invalid training timestamps fail closed. Aggregate preprobe counts must exactly equal M1 train-spike counts for chosen units. Explicit observation coverage from M1 source array coverage.

Execute smoke one session, small cohort first two subjects, full eligible cohort in strict order; output real stage QC and integer counts/exposure. Training-only sparsity feasibility review describes observed sparsity and retains frozen 100ms without manufacturing a new sparsity exclusion threshold; no convergence claim before models are fitted.

Add unit tests for boundaries -6,-5.9,-0.1,0, complete zero arrays, trial reset, malformed heldout timestamps/units ignored, mismatch/hash rejection, real shapes/count conservation and eligibility. Temp tests within workspace. Test fixtures not scientific findings.

Produce run_m2.py executable, automated tests real tests.txt, execution logs, QC_REPORT.md and qc_report.json, gate_result.json, claim_audit.json, feature manifest SHA256, reproducibility docs and one-command PowerShell runner. Gate must derive from actual checks/tests, not hardcoded PASS. Test subprocess failures FAIL. Record validation/test timestamp access false, scientific verdict NOT_EVALUATED. No M3 or other milestone. Main orchestrator reviews then advances. Do NOT edit MILESTONE_STATUS or ops or git commits.

Run PowerShell reproduction in staging, then orchestrator reruns in actual workspace. Avoid git-ignored raw acquisition changes. Preserve negative runs. Return changed files and exact execution evidence.
constraints: No paper1-paper10 changes, M0/M1 source/results/locks mutations, holdout inspection, external calls, simulated findings, downstream model code or scientific verdicts.

criteria: M2 real training cohort features/tests pass; all count sums match frozen M1 and hashes unchanged; zero heldout count access
